observation_text: - English observation: The local image shows a pointed, closed outer outline with a short oblique interior stroke and a narrow tail continuing below the outline. - 中文观察: 本地图像有尖顶闭合外轮廓，内部有短斜向笔画，轮廓下方另有窄长尾部。

- English observation: The image shows a horizontal rounded rectangular outline with one short vertical stroke near the center and no other visible interior marks. - 中文观察: 图像有横向圆角矩形外轮廓，中部附近有一道短竖画，内部未见其他明显痕迹。
- English observation: The image shows a thick circular ring surrounding one separate filled round mark at the center. - 中文观察: 图像有粗圆环，中央包围一处分离的实心圆形痕迹。

- English observation: The image has a rounded horizontal central outline with a short inner stroke, two detached side marks, and short horizontal marks above and below. - 中文观察: 图像中央有横向圆弧外轮廓和短内部笔画，两侧有分离痕迹，上下另有短横画。

- English observation: The image shows a small upper rounded rectangle with a short inner bar, a longer horizontal bar below, and one long stroke descending from it. - 中文观察: 图像上部有小型圆角矩形和短内横画，下方有较长横画，并向下延出长笔画。
- English observation: The image shows an upper rounded rectangle with a short inner bar and a separate square outline below it. - 中文观察: 图像上部有圆角矩形和短内横画，下方另有分离的方框轮廓。
- English observation: The upper part contains several short angular strokes in two dense rows; a separate rounded outline with a short inner mark sits below. - 中文观察: 上部有两排密集的短折角笔画，下方另有带短内部痕迹的圆弧外轮廓。

- English observation: The upper part shows crossing diagonal and upright strokes with long lower tails; a separate rounded square with an inner bar sits below. - 中文观察: 上部有交叉斜向和直立笔画，并向下延出长尾；下方另有带内横画的圆角方框。
- English observation: The image shows a long curved outer stroke and a central descending stroke ending at a rounded enclosure with a filled interior mark. - 中文观察: 图像有长弯曲外侧笔画和中央下行笔画，下端接圆弧外框，内部有实心痕迹。
- English observation: The image shows a long curved left stroke and a central descending stroke ending at a rounded enclosure with a filled interior mark. - 中文观察: 图像有左侧长弯曲笔画和中央下行笔画，下端接圆弧外框，内部有实心痕迹。
